title: Facial soft-tissue thickness (forensic tissue depth tables)

queue.claim: Supine-to-upright change is under 1 mm at midline sites and ~1-3 mm at lateral and lower-face sites (Munn & Stephan 2018, Forensic Sci Int); hence a sigma inflation of 0.05-0.10 for supine CT/MRI-derived data
queue.query: Munn Stephan 2018 changes in face topography supine to upright soft tissue correction values craniofacial identification

queue.claim: Blender Geometry Nodes workflow: Object Info -> Geometry Proximity or Raycast -> Store Named Attribute (fstt_mm) -> Color Ramp; the Solidify modifier vertex-group thickness factor works for a variable-thickness envelope
queue.query: Blender manual Geometry Proximity node Raycast node Store Named Attribute Solidify modifier vertex group thickness factor
